title: AYO WTF?!
blurb: An emergency brake for a conversation that has abruptly gone somewhere it should not have gone. Shock and accusation arrive together in a single syllable cluster, and the demand is that everybody present stop and review what was just said. Play it when the group chat turns, when song lyrics are properly heard for the first time after years of singing them, or when a plot twist arrives with no warning whatsoever. Constitutionally protected reaction audio. Long may it remain so.
